notes.title: AIPD - Release date
notes.notes:
Hello together,

We are very happy to announce you the release date for AIPD. ːsteamhappyː
On the 29th of January 2016, AIPD will be available for PC, Xbox One & Playstation 4.

Best regards,
The AIPD-Team
